story_beats.visual_prompt: Felix the Ferret and Pip the Marten stand smiling inside the village marketplace as the wooden storage door swings wide open. The brass key rests securely on a small wooden ledge between them inside the sunlit doorway.

proposal.central_conflict: Felix and Pip both claim full possession of the single brass stall key, blocking joint access to the marketplace storage partition.
proposal.decisive_choice: Felix and Pip place the brass key into the shared door lock together and turn it in alternating sequence to verify equal access.
proposal.resolution: The storage partition door opens smoothly for both merchants, establishing a permanent fair-share agreement for the marketplace.
